主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. reported no material changes in internal control over financial reporting during its fiscal year ended December 31, 2018. The company confirmed that Mr. Marcel R. Coutu qualifies as an audit committee financial expert and is independent under NYSE standards. BAM adopted a Code of Business Conduct and Ethics applicable to its senior officers and key employees, available on its website. The code is also available in print upon request. All amendments and waivers related to the code are promptly posted online. The company has no off-balance sheet arrangements. Information on principal accountant fees and pre-approval policies is included in its Annual Information Form. BAM maintains a separately designated audit committee with members Marcel R. Coutu, M. Elyse Allan, Angela F. Braly, and Rafael Miranda.
